bindingNote: The binding map above is the single source every generator and gate reads: each port binds to its nearer branch by verified road distance (PhilaPort binds on drive time only — road miles are tied, and no mileage advantage may be claimed for it). Terminal-to-branch odometer readings at execution time can refine, never silently replace, this table; any change re-runs gate PB-1. Port of Huntington Tri-State added 2026-11-07 (WV-2): bound to Winchester on miles (312.8 mi vs 357.7-360.4 mi from Martinsburg). Port of New York and New Jersey added 2026-11-10 (Port #8): bound to Martinsburg on miles — OSRM road routing measured 2026-11-10 from both branches to the Elizabeth Marine Terminal point (40.68155, -74.1505): Martinsburg 251.1 mi / about 5:10 against Winchester 275.6 mi / about 5:37, a margin of about 24.5 mi.

notOffered: drayage — the company does not run port drayage; freight moves to and from the ports on the customer's or carrier's trucks, and the company's crews do the hands-on work at the delivery points in the coverage matrix
offerSet.crewCredentialWording: The company's crews hold TWIC cards and its contractors hold valid TWIC cards. That is the settled wording: card-holding by crews and contractors, never a company-level certification, and never a claim of port tenancy or a port-authority relationship.

statusItems.state: The ExpressRail system is a $600M Port Authority program with 1.5M annual rail-lift capacity across four facilities — Elizabeth (Maher and APM), Newark (PNCT), Staten Island (Port Liberty New York) and Port Jersey (Port Liberty Bayonne) — served by the port's two Class I partners, CSX and Norfolk Southern.
